component.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
component.general.generateAtlas.tooltip: Enable atlas generation. When disabled, unused UV areas are kept (no repack), whole textures are scaled only.
component.general.qualityPreset.tooltip: Quality preset controls the target quality thresholds. Custom uses user-defined thresholds (near-lossless by default).
component.general.targetPlatform.tooltip: Target platform for texture settings. Auto uses current build platform.
component.density.min.tooltip: Minimum pixel density. Prevents blurring on small objects.
component.density.max.tooltip: Maximum pixel density. Prevents waste of texture space.
component.atlas.padding.tooltip: Padding between UV islands (pixels). Higher values reduce bleeding but reduce density.
component.atlas.npot.tooltip: Generate non-power-of-two atlases at 64px steps. Disables incompatible formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS).
component.dedup.enabled.tooltip: Deduplicate identical materials/textures after optimization and merge identical material slots when safe.
component.adv.verbose.tooltip: Show detailed processing logs in the NDMF console.
component.adv.gpu.tooltip: Enable GPU-accelerated quality evaluation and atlas dilation.
component.whitelist.tooltip: Objects in the whitelist are skipped from all optimization (textures they reference keep original; same-UV other textures still participate in non-atlas optimizations).
error.noAvatarDescriptor: AvatarTextureOptimizer requires a VRCAvatarDescriptor (or Animator) on the same GameObject. Processing aborted.
error.multipleComponents: Multiple AvatarTextureOptimizer components found in the avatar hierarchy. Please keep exactly one.
warning.textureNoReadable: Texture '{0}' is not readable; skipping optimization for this texture.
warning.uvWrapCross: UVs on renderer '{0}' (channel {1}) cross wrap seams; skipping atlas optimization for these UVs.
warning.shaderUnsupported: Shader '{0}' on material '{1}' could not be fully analyzed; treating as whitelist.
warning.textureTooLargeForAtlas: UV group '{0}' cannot fit into the maximum atlas size; skipping atlas for this group.
warning.npotPVRTC: NPOT is enabled but PVRTC (iOS) does not support NPOT; falling back to a compatible format.
